items.title: Release notes: see what's new
items.text: Find out what has changed with each update. You can open these notes any time from the Feedback menu.

items.title: Feedback menu reorganised, ideas in a table
items.text: The Feedback menu is now a single page: write to us at the top, and below it find all ideas from other teams in one table and vote on them.

image.name: r13-feedback
image.alt: The Feedback menu: a box to write to us, below it a list of ideas with votes

items.title: Anonymous voting, hardened
items.text: In anonymous mode, nobody can see whose card is whose after the reveal. We have now also closed the technical gaps behind the scenes. Emojis still work.
items.where: Board settings → Results → Names on revealed cards → Anonymous

items.title: AI connector: join with your AI assistant (beta)
items.text: Add Agile Poker as a connector (MCP) in Claude or ChatGPT and give your assistant the invite link. It takes a seat under the name you choose, plays the cards you tell it to and keeps you posted. It sees the same board you do. This is a beta, so please send us feedback and let us know how it works for you.

image.name: r10-ai
image.alt: The window "Play via your AI assistant" with the link to copy and three short steps

items.title: See who is playing through an AI
items.text: A small robot next to a name shows who is playing through an AI assistant. If your team would rather not have this, turn AI assistants off for the whole board.
items.where: Board settings → Team → Allow AI assistants → Off

items.title: Open API: connect Jira and other tools
items.text: Agile Poker now has a public, documented API. Use it to send items from Jira (for example with Jira Automation) or from your own tools straight to your list of items to estimate. Create a key in the You menu and treat it like a password; the "API docs" link next to it explains how it all works.

image.name: r9-apikeys
image.alt: The section "API keys" in the You menu with a field for the name of the key and the button "Create key"

items.title: Your settings in one place
items.text: Your name, your role, light or dark mode and "Delete my data" are now all in one menu.

items.title: Removed players now appear as observers
items.text: If you take someone off the table while they still have the board open, they now appear among the observers – so you always know who is watching.

items.title: Faster page load
items.text: Card sets and symbols now load in parallel in the background, and the board appears in one go, fully drawn – no more half-built board and no frozen browser on slow connections.

items.title: Less emoji spam
items.text: Fish raining down all session? Now everyone can throw each emoji once a day, so meetings stay focused. The emoji bar shows which ones you have left.
items.where: hover over a card on the table and click the smiley (on a phone or tablet: tap the card, then the smiley)

items.title: A list of items to estimate
items.text: Add your backlog items to a list and estimate them one after another – no need to type a new topic each time.

image.name: r4-items
image.alt: The Topic menu with the tab Items: a list of four items, the first one is being estimated

items.title: Estimation history
items.text: See the final estimate and all votes for every item you have finished. Export them as CSV or copy them to your clipboard.

image.name: r4-done
image.alt: The Topic menu with the tab Done: two finished items with their agreed values, and the buttons Copy and Download CSV

items.title: Show the median
items.text: After the reveal, a dashed line in the result chart marks the median. Unlike the average, it is not skewed by a single outlier.
items.where: Board settings → Results → Average and median → Show

items.title: Nudge sound
items.text: When someone nudges you, you now hear a short sound – even when the board is in a background tab. You can turn the sound off.
items.where: You → Play a sound when someone nudges you

items.title: Collapse or resize the sidebar
items.text: Collapse the sidebar to get more space for the cards, or make it wider. Your setting is saved.
items.where: the arrows at the top of the sidebar

items.title: Card changes after the reveal stay visible
items.text: If someone changes their card after the reveal, their first card stays visible underneath – so the team can still talk about the original estimate.
items.where: Board settings → Results → Changed cards → Show

items.title: Rich cards – with title, description and layout options
items.text: Give your cards a title, a short description and a symbol, and choose a layout. Card sets such as "Delegation Poker" and "Consent decision" use them – and so can your own card sets.

image.name: r3-rich
image.alt: Delegation Poker cards on the table, each with a number, a title like "Consult" and a short explanation

items.title: Create your own card sets
items.text: Build your own card set with your own values, colours and texts – for your whole team.
items.where: Board settings → Deck → Change → New set

image.name: r3-own
image.alt: The editor for your own card set: the set name, the list of cards, and the card M with the title "Medium", a short description and a colour

items.title: Throw emojis and nudge
items.text: Throw emojis at your teammates' cards – or give someone a nudge.
items.where: hover over a card on the table and click the smiley (on a phone or tablet: tap the card, then the smiley)

image.name: r3-emoji
image.alt: The emoji bar above a teammate's card: seven emojis to throw, and below the card the buttons for nudge and emojis

items.title: Observers on the board, away status on the cards
items.text: Observers now appear on the board, below the cards. Cards also show when a player is away or has lost their connection.

items.title: Keyboard shortcuts for your cards
items.text: Each of your cards has its own key (Q, W, E …), so you can play a card without touching the mouse.

items.title: Results moved to the sidebar
items.text: The bar chart with the result of a round is now in the sidebar, next to the topic, leaving more room for the cards on the table.
items.where: the sidebar on the right (phones: above your cards)

image.name: r2-result
image.alt: The result in the sidebar: a bar for each card value with the number of votes, a marker for the average and a line for the median

items.title: Timebox with countdown
items.text: Set a timebox, for example 5 or 10 minutes, and everyone sees the same countdown.
items.where: Timer → On → Mode: Timer (not Stopwatch), then pick the minutes

image.name: r2-countdown
image.alt: The countdown at the bottom right with 4 minutes 51 seconds left, above the buttons for a new round and the next item

items.title: Timer restarts with every new round
items.text: Click "New round" and the timer starts again automatically.

items.title: Swipe through your cards
items.text: On phones and tablets, swipe through your cards and tap the middle one to play it.

items.title: A fresh new look
items.text: A calmer, tidier board with a clear place for the topic, the table and your cards – in light and dark mode.

image.name: r1-board
image.alt: The whole board: the menu at the top, the table with cards, the sidebar and your cards at the bottom

items.title: Works on phones and tablets
items.text: The board adapts to any screen size, menus slide up from the bottom on phones, and every button is easy to tap.
items.where: open the board link on your phone

image.name: r1-phone
image.alt: The board on a phone: the table with cards, and your cards to swipe through at the bottom

items.title: Send us feedback
items.text: Report a problem or suggest an idea right from the board, and vote on what others have asked for.
